name: luh-additive-manufacturing-data-from-a-parameter-study-on-316l-cucrzr-multi-material-specimens
notes:
This dataset was generated in the context of a parameter study in the paper:
_Supplementary data of “Additive manufacturing of multi-material parts – Influence of process parameters on interface formation in in-plane 316L/CuCrZr laser powder bed fusion"_ 

It includes: 1. Design data, 2. Preparation data, 3. In-situ camera snapshots, 4. Physical photos after manufacturing

* __Materials:__ 316L (Carpenter Additive) and CuCrZr (Eckart TLS GmbH)
* __Design:__ Autodesk Inventor Professional 2022
* __Data preparation:__ Autodesk Netfabb Ultimate 2021
* __PBF-LB Machine:__ Aconity MIDI+ equipped with an integrated Aerosint SPD Recoater V1.0
* __Software:__ AconitySTUDIO
* __Process monitoring:__ High-speed CMOS camera

![ Arrangement of the 316L/CuCrZr multi-material specimens on the build platform for the parameter study]( https://data.uni-hannover.de/de/dataset/8062e5f1-c882-477d-8f4a-43fbdd8b3490/resource/5ac01325-a503-44b4-bd9c-b049735158b2/download/arrangement_specimens_build-platform.png)
Arrangement of the 316L/CuCrZr multi-material specimens on the build platform for the parameter study

### References

Meyer, I., Oel, M., Ehlers, T., & Lachmayer, R. (2023). *Additive manufacturing of multi-material parts – Design guidelines for manufacturing of 316L/CuCrZr in laser powder bed fusion*. Heliyon, 9(8), e18301. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2023.e18301

Ina Meyer, Roland Lachmayer (2025). *µCT data from a parameter study on 316L/CuCrZr multi-material specimens* [Data set]. LUIS. https://doi.org/10.25835/bi1jbiq9

Ina Meyer, Roland Lachmayer (2025). *Light microscopy data from a parameter study on 316L/CuCrZr multi-material specimens* [Data set]. LUIS. https://doi.org/10.25835/rsjz3w2k

Ina Meyer, Roland Lachmayer (2025). *SEM data from a parameter study on 316L/CuCrZr multi-material specimens* [Data set]. LUIS. https://doi.org/10.25835/wan2sabi
